bio: Keeping an eye on any topics about $AVGO. All comments are for informational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice. DYOR!
name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: The $400M JV itself dates to July, so today's approval is a green light, not a new deal. Panel-level packaging only matters if yields hold at scale. 2028 production is the date to watch. $AVGO
惠誉维持博通 A-、正面展望，理由是现金生成强、杠杆低于上调门槛，同时点名表外融资敞口日趋复杂。据彭博报道，银行计划明年一季度发约 210 亿美元债，把部分贷款转给债市。订单故事不缺钱，接下来看的是钱的代价。$AVGO

Talks, not a done deal yet. Buying the optics stack doesn't automatically win the switch socket. Tomahawk got there on deployments, and that's the harder part to copy. CPO is the pitch, installed base is the proof. $AVGO

The customer link is what makes this one land. Broadcom named as a major WIN customer ties the optical ramp back to a real buyer, though CW lasers and EML at 2028 still leave a long runway for timing to slip. $AVGO

If TPUs turn into a product Google actually sells instead of only running internally, the read-across for Broadcom is pretty direct: outside TPU demand lands on the same roadmap. Still reported, not confirmed, and the 2027 Oracle timeline is the part to watch. $AVGO
Celestica 在电话会上更新了 CPO 的进展：博通 Tomahawk 6 Davisson 芯片的功能平台已经点亮，正在测试，1.6T 机架级方案和一家超大规模客户合作设计制造，量产爬坡定在 2027 年底。从演示到可制造的系统，关键看接下来测试和良率。$AVGO

That $120B bar has aged fast. It looked like a stretch when it was set, and the FY28 guide now sits well above it. Still a guide, not revenue in the bank. FY28-30 leaves plenty of room for orders to slip.

Incremental margin is the right lens here. It says how much of each extra revenue dollar actually reaches operating profit, and on this table that conversion has stayed high. Scale matters, but only if it converts like this. $AVGO

Breadth is the point here: Meta, Google and OpenAI custom silicon in one KeyBanc update. If Broadcom holds the inference-heavy SKUs, that's the part to watch. Broker note, not a company confirmation. $AVGO

If this holds, the constraint moves a step downstream. Packaging capacity, not just wafers, sets the pace for custom accelerators, and a 10-20% price move would hit exactly there. Still reported, not TSMC confirmed. $AVGO
Fair point, the VMware overhang explains a lot of the debt load. Whether that deleveraging keeps pace is the thing to watch, with the stock still sitting below its 20-, 50- and 200-day averages.
630 亿美元这笔 Anthropic 算力融资，结构比数字有意思：华尔街四家出钱，SPV 买博通的定制 XPU 和组网设备租给 Anthropic，2027 年起交付。招股书里博通是最大算力对手方，约 1610 亿美元。但 Anthropic 上半年还亏 807 亿，兑现节奏得盯着。$AVGO
